arabic text: AYE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD
english translation text: OH AUN AND MUHAMMAD

arabic text: SHABBIR KA TUM SADKA HO, AB KHAIME MAI BETA, TUM LAUT KARNA AANA
english translation text: YOU HAVE BEEN SACRIFICED FOR SHABBIR (A.S), NOW O MY SONS, DO NOT RETURN TO THE TENTS

arabic text: HAI MAA KO YAQEEN, TUM MAA KI BAAT RAKHOGE,
english translation text: YOUR MOTHER HAS CONFIDENCE THAT YOU WOULD LISTEN TO HER

arabic text: YEH YAAD RAHE, KHAIMO MAI HAI PYAASE BACHE,
english translation text: REMEMBER THAT THERE ARE THIRSTY CHILDREN IN THE TENTS

arabic text: DARIYA PE AGAR JAANA HO, SEH ROZ KE PYAASO, TUM PYAAS NA BUJHAANA
english translation text: IF YOU REACH THE RIVER, OH MY THIRSTY CHILDREN, DO NOT QUENCH YOUR THIRST

arabic text: HAR HAAL PE TUM PAR, LAAZIM HAI SHUKR KHUDA KA,
english translation text: YOU ARE OBLIGATED TO THANK GOD AT EVERY SITUATION

arabic text: AYE SHEHZAADON, HAI SABR TUMHAARA VIRSAA,
english translation text: O MY PRINCES’, PATIENCE IS YOUR INHERITTANCE

arabic text: FARZAND HO TUM ZAINAB KE, SHIKWA NAHI KARNA, JAB ZAKHM KOI KHAANA
english translation text: YOU ARE THE BOYS OF ZAINAB (A.S), DO NOT COMPLAIN WHEN YOU ARE INFLICTED WITH ANY INJURY

arabic text: KAB HAM PE SITAM, KARNE KE LIYE AAYE HAI,
english translation text: WHEN HAVE THEY COME TO INFLICT PAIN ON US?

arabic text: YEH BADRO-OHAD KE, BADLE KE LIYE AAYE HAI
english translation text: THEY HAVE ACTUALLY COME TO AVENGE THE BATTLES OF BADR AND UHUD

arabic text: LAAZIM HAI RAJAZ SE PEHLE, MAIDAAN MAI TUM PAR, MADHE-ALI SUNAANA
english translation text: BEFORE YOU ENTER THE BATTLEFIELD, YOU ARE OBLIGATED TO SING THE PRAISES OF ALI (A.S)

arabic text: JAB SAANS TUMHAARI, BACHO HO UTARNE WAALI,
english translation text: WHEN YOU ARE ABOUT TO BREATHE YOUR LAST, O MY SONS…

arabic text: USS WAQT SIRHAANE, AAYEGI MAADAR MERI,
english translation text: AT THAT TIME, MY MOTHER (BIBI FATIMA) WILL BE PRESENT BESIDES YOU

arabic text: DIL KI YEH MERI KHWAAHISH HAI, USS DAM MERI MAA SE, ZAKHMON KO TUM CHHUPAANA
english translation text: IT IS MY EARNEST REQUEST FOR YOU TO PLEASE HIDE YOUR INJURIES FROM HER AT THAT TIME

arabic text: QAATIL PE KARAM, NANA KI TARHA KARDENA,
english translation text: HAVE MERCY ON YOUR KILLER, THE WAY YOUR GRANDFATHER DID

arabic text: YUN LAAJ MERE, BHAI KE NAAM KI RAKHNA,
english translation text: THIS WAY, YOU WOULD KEEP THE RESPECT OF MY BROTHER’S NAME

arabic text: JO WAASTA DE BHAI KA, MAIDAAN PE USS PAR, TUM TEGH NA CHALAANA
english translation text: ANYONE ON THE BATTLEFIELD, WHO PLEADS USING MY BROTHER’S NAME, DO NOT ATTACK HIM

arabic text: JAB LAASHE UTHAAKAR, KHAIME MAI LAAYE SARWAR,
english translation text: WHEN SARWAR (IMAM HUSSAIN) BROUGHT THE CORPSES OF THE BOYS TO THE TENT

arabic text: ZAINAB YEH BOLI, ASKHON KO APNE CHHUPAAKAR,
english translation text: ZAINAB (A.S) SAID, HIDING HER TEARS…

arabic text: MAI BHI NA TUMHE ROWUNGI, AUR MERE LIYE BHI, AANSU NA TUM BAHAANA
english translation text: 'I WILL NOT CRY FOR YOU…AND YOU DO NOT SHED TEARS FOR ME TOO'

arabic text: TAAZEEM KI KHAATIR, KYUN UTHTE NAHI AB BETA,
english translation text: WHY HAVEN’T YOU STOOD UP OUT OF RESPECT, OH MY SONS?

arabic text: DEKHO TOH SIRHAANE, AAYE HAI MERE BHAYYA,
english translation text: LOOK MY BROTHER HAS COME BESIDES YOU

arabic text: JAAGO MERE SHEHZAADO, KYA BHOOLGAYE HO, QADMO PE SAR JHUKAANA
english translation text: WAKE UP, O MY PRINCES’, HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN TO BOW YOUR HEADS ON HIS FEET?

arabic text: SHABAASH MERE, BACHO HUN MAI TUMSE RAAZI,
english translation text: 'BRAVO MY SONS! YOUR MOTHER IS PLEASED WITH YOU'

arabic text: YEH KEHKE TAKALLUM, KHAMOSH HUWI SHAHZAADI,\n(ZAINAB A.S)
english translation text: BECAME SILENT…\nSAYING THIS, PRINCESS

arabic text: NEZO PE SAFAR KARKE, HAMRAAH HAMAARE, TUMKO HAI SHAAM JAANA
english translation text: 'WITH YOUR HEADS ON SPEARS, YOU WILL BE ACCOMPANYING US ALL THE WAY TO SHAAM'

arabic text: KEHTI THI YE ZAINAB YUN MAA KA MAAN NIBHANA\nAY AUNO-MOHAMAD AY AUNO-MOHAMAD
english translation text: ZAINAB (A.S) SAID TO HER SONS, 'O AUN\nAND MUHAMMAD, MAKE YOUR MOTHER PROUD OF YOU.'

arabic text: HAI MAA KO YAQEEN TUM MAA KI BAAT RAKHOGE, YE YAAD RAHE QAIMO MAY HAI PYASE BACHE\nDARYA PE AGAR JAANA HO SEH ROZ KE PYASO, TUM PYAS NA BUJHANA AY AUNO-MOHAMAD\nO AUN & MUHAMMAD
english translation text: YOUR MOTHER KNOWS THAT YOU WILL STAY TRUE TO HER,\nREMEMBER THAT THERE ARE THIRSTY CHILDREN IN THE TENTS,\nIF YOU HAPPEN TO REACH THE RIVER, OH MY THIRSTY SONS DO NOT QUENCH YOUR THIRST,

arabic text: HAR HAAL MAY TUM PAR LAAZIM HAI SHUKR KHUDA KA, AY SHEHZADO HAI SABR TUMHARA VIRSA\nFARZAND HO TUM ZAINAB KE SHIKWA NAHI KARNA, JAB ZAKHM KOI KHANA\nO AUN & MUHAMMAD
english translation text: YOU HAVE TO BE IN A STATE OF GRATITUDE TO ALLAH AT\nALL TIMES, O MY PRINCES, PATIENCE IS IN YOUR LEGACY, YOU ARE\nTHE SONS OF ZAINAB, DO NOT COMPLAIN, WHEN YOU ARE INJURED,

arabic text: KAB HUMPE SITAM KARNE KE LIYE AAYE HAI, YEH BADRO OHAD KE BADLE KE LIYE AAYE HAI\nLAAZIM HAI RAZAZ SE PEHLE MAIDAN MAY TUM PAR, MADHE ALI SUNANA AY AUNO-MOHAMAD
english translation text: THEY HAVE NOT JUST COME TO ATTACK US, IN FACT THEY HAVE COME TO TAKE REVENGE FOR BADR\n& UHUD AS WELL, YOU MUST SING THE PRAISES OF ALI BEFORE YOU INTRODUCE YOURSELF IN THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: JAB SAANS TUMHARI BACHON HO UKHARNE WALI, US WAQT SIRHANE AAYENGI MADAR MERI\nDIL KI YE MERE KHWAHISH HAI US DAM MERI MAA SE, ZAKHMON KO TUM CHUPANA
english translation text: WHEN YOU ARE TAKING YOUR LAST BREATHS, THEN MY MOTHER FATIMA (A.S.) WILL COME AND VISIT YOU,\nIT IS MY WISH THAT YOU HIDE YOUR WOUNDS FROM HER

arabic text: KHAATIL PE KARAM NANA KI TARHA KAR DENA, YUN LAAJ MERE BHAI KE NAAM KI RAKHNA\nJO WAASTA DE BHAI KA MAIDAN PE US PAR, TUM TAYGH NA CHALANA
english translation text: LIKE YOUR GRANDFATHER, HAVE MERCY ON YOUR KILLER, PROTECT THE HONOUR OF YOUR UNCLE,\nWHOEVER BESEECHES YOU IN THE NAME OF MY BROTHER, DO NOT HURT HIM

arabic text: JAB LAASHE UTHAAKAR QAIME MAY LAAYE SARWAR, ZAINAB YE BOLI ASKHON KO APNE CHUPAKAR\nMAI BHI NA TUMHE RO-UNGI AUR MERE LIYE BHI, AANSU NA TUM BAHANA
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) CARRIED THEIR BODIES BACK TO THE TENT, HIDING HER TEARS, ZAINAB (A.S.) SAID, I\nWILL NOT CRY FOR YOU, O MY SONS, AND NOR SHOULD YOU SHED ANY TEARS FOR ME

arabic text: TAAZEEM KI KHAATIR KYUN UT-THAY NAHI AB BETA, DEKHO TO SIRHANE AAYE HAI MERE BHAIYA\nJAAGO MERE SHEHZADO KYA BHOOLGAYE HO, QADMO PE SAR JHUKANA
english translation text: WHY HAVE YOU NOT STOOD UP OUT OF RESPECT, O MY SONS, MY BROTHER HUSSAIN (A.S.) IS\nSTANDING NEAR YOU, WAKE UP MY PRINCES, HAVE YOU FORGOTTEN TO BOW YOUR HEADS DOWN IN RESPECT.

arabic text: SHABASH MERE BACHON HOO MAI TUMSE RAAZI, YEH KEHKE TAKALLUM KHAMOSH HUVI SHAHZADI\nNAIZO PE SAFAR KARKE HAMRAAH HAMAARE, TUMKO HAI SHAAM JAANA
english translation text: WELL DONE MY SONS, I AM PROUD OF YOU, ZAINAB (A.S.) BECAME QUIET AFTER SAYING THIS,\nYOU WILL HAVE TO TRAVEL WITH YOUR HEADS ON SPEARS ALONGSIDE ME ON THE WAY TO SHAAM
